name: decision-science-skills
description: Structured-judgment methods from intelligence, military, forecasting, and system-dynamics practice: competing-hypotheses analysis, reference-class forecasting (outside view), pre-mortem, after-action review, tabletop wargaming with commander's intent, principled negotiation (Fisher/Ury + Voss), the-challenger revision review (zero-based continue-vs-revise decisions that momentum and sunk costs suppress), and systems-thinking (stocks/flows, feedback loops, delays, archetypes, leverage points).
